description: Commands agents in the 3D virtual office to move. The backend only issues the command; the open viewer (the console's /office/ page) does the pathfinding and walking, then reports back on arrival. action: goto walks to a place (or next to an agent), find goes to look for an agent, return goes back to the agent's own seat, stop halts; or give only text (for example "engineer go to meeting", "ceo find narrator", "all return to seats"; separate several commands with ; and they are split into separate commands). Agents and places are validated first and an invalid one returns an error. With no viewer connected the command status is no_viewer (it is not executed and is not sent later). With wait set to a number of seconds, the call waits until all commands have arrived (or failed, been superseded, or timed out) before returning. Use office_state to look up agent ids and place ids. Command statuses: pending (not yet sent), delivered (reached the viewer), running (walking), arrived, done (stop completed), partial (partly failed), failed, superseded (replaced by a newer command), no_viewer.

action.description: goto, find, return or stop (not needed when text is given)

agents.description: Array of agent ids (for example ["engineer","ceo"]); localized names or aliases are also accepted, and ["all"] means every agent

target.description: goto: a place id (for example meeting, pantry, lounge, seat_ceo, zone_engineer) or an agent id (same as find); find: an agent id. Not used by return or stop

text.description: A natural-language command (English or Chinese); when given, do not also give action / agents / target

wait.description: Seconds to wait for arrival, 0-120, default 0 (do not wait; return the command id and status immediately)

name: office_move
title: Virtual office: move agents

description: Current state of the 3D virtual office: the connected viewers (which one is the primary viewer), each agent's last reported position, state (idle, walking, waiting, arrived), whether it is seated and its current place, the recent commands and each agent's command status, plus the available place ids and names. Read-only.

command.description: Show only the status of this command id

limit.description: Maximum number of recent commands to list, default 20, max 200

name: office_state
title: Virtual office: state

annotations.title: Withdraw a pending decision / help request

description: Withdraws a decision or help request that is still open (status=open). Allowed for the creator or an organization admin; anyone else gets 403, and an item that is not open gets 409. The withdrawn item stays visible with status=withdrawn. Console-only tool, forwarded to the core's POST /api/orgs/{org}/decisions/{id}/withdraw. Returns the updated item.
name: issue_decision_withdraw
title: Withdraw a pending decision / help request

annotations.title: Reopen a handled decision / help request

description: Reopens a decision or help request that has already been handled (status=decided): the answer, note and evidence are cleared and it is open again, and a comment is written on the source issue. Allowed for an organization admin or the original handler; anyone else gets 403, and an item that is not decided gets 409. Humans only (agent credentials are rejected). Console-only tool, forwarded to the core's POST /api/orgs/{org}/decisions/{id}/reopen. Returns the updated item.
name: issue_decision_reopen
title: Reopen a handled decision / help request
